title: The Condensation of Collagen Leads to an Extended Standing Time and a Decreased Pro -inflammatory Tissue Response to a Newly Developed Pericardium-based Barrier Membrane for Guided Bone Regeneration
authors: Gueldenpfennig T, Houshmand A, Najman S, Stojanovic S, Korzinskas T, Smeets R, Gosau M, Pissarek J, Emmert S, Jung O, Barbeck M. In Vivo. 2020 May-Jun;34(3):985-1000. doi: 10.21873/invivo.11867.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The CPM is fully biocompatible and seems to support the early healing process. Moreover, the new biomaterial seems to prevent cell ingrowth for a longer period of time, making it ideally suited for GBR procedures” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
